questions.question: What happened every seventh year regarding debts?
options: They were doubled as a penalty
They passed to the firstborn son
They had to be repaid in full

questions.question: How were they to treat the poor?
options: Be openhanded and generous, lending freely
Turn them away and lend them nothing at all
Charge them interest on every loan made
Keep your distance and avoid them always
questions.answer: Be openhanded and generous, lending freely

questions.question: A Hebrew servant freed in the seventh year was not to be sent away empty-handed.
At the end of every _____ years, creditors were to cancel debts.
"You shall open wide your _____ to your poor brother," Moses said.
